verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions can be triggered automatically by server events, webhooks, and schedules, so Appwrite documents its own event-driven automation. The evidence does not show a declarative rule layer: no documented event-filter or condition configuration, and actions must be written as function code. Missing for 10: documented declarative or conditional rule definition (event filters, conditions) without custom code, details on how event subscriptions are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: These Functions can be triggered by HTTP requests, SDK methods, server events, webhooks, and scheduled executions.
Run API endpoints, webhooks, cron jobs, and event handlers in secure isolated runtimes that scale with demand.
Respond to server events in realtime.
